verses.ar: «أَتَعْرِفُ وَقْتَ وِلَادَةِ وُعُولِ ٱلصُّخُورِ، أَوْ تُلَاحِظُ مَخَاضَ ٱلْأَيَائِلِ؟
verses.kjv: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? [or] canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.web: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

verses.ar: أَتَحْسُبُ ٱلشُّهُورَ ٱلَّتِي تُكَمِّلُهَا، أَوْ تَعْلَمُ مِيقَاتَ وِلَادَتِهِنَّ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou number the months [that] they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
verses.web: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

verses.ar: يَبْرُكْنَ وَيَضَعْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ. يَدْفَعْنَ أَوْجَاعَهُنَّ.
verses.kjv: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
verses.web: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

verses.ar: تَبْلُغُ أَوْلَادُهُنَّ. تَرْبُو فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ. تَخْرُجُ وَلَا تَعُودُ إِلَيْهِنَّ.
verses.kjv: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
verses.web: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

verses.ar: «مَنْ سَرَّحَ ٱلْفَرَاءَ حُرًّا، وَمَنْ فَكَّ رُبُطَ حِمَارِ ٱلْوَحْشِ؟
verses.kjv: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
verses.web: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلْتُ ٱلْبَرِّيَّةَ بَيْتَهُ وَٱلسِّبَاخَ مَسْكَنَهُ.
verses.kjv: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
verses.web: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

verses.ar: يَضْحَكُ عَلَى جُمْهُورِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ. لَا يَسْمَعُ زَجْرَ ٱلسَّائِقِ.
verses.kjv: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
verses.web: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

verses.ar: دَائِرَةُ ٱلْجِبَالِ مَرْعَاهُ، وَعَلَى كُلِّ خُضْرَةٍ يُفَتِّشُ.
verses.kjv: The range of the mountains [is] his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
verses.web: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

verses.ar: «أَيَرْضَى ٱلثَّوْرُ ٱلْوَحْشِيُّ أَنْ يَخْدُمَكَ، أَمْ يَبِيتُ عِنْدَ مِعْلَفِكَ؟
verses.kjv: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
verses.web: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

verses.ar: أَتَرْبِطُ ٱلثَّوْرَ ٱلْوَحْشِيَّ بِرِبَاطِهِ فِي ٱلتَّلْمِ، أَمْ يُمَهِّدُ ٱلْأَوْدِيَةَ وَرَاءَكَ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
verses.web: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

verses.ar: أَتَثِقُ بِهِ لِأَنَّ قُوَّتَهُ عَظِيمَةٌ، أَوْ تَتْرُكُ لَهُ تَعَبَكَ؟
verses.kjv: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength [is] great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
verses.web: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

verses.ar: أَتَأْتَمِنُهُ أَنَّهُ يَأْتِي بِزَرْعِكَ وَيُجْمَعُ إِلَى بَيْدَرِكَ؟
verses.kjv: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather [it into] thy barn?
verses.web: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

verses.ar: «جَنَاحُ ٱلنَّعَامَةِ يُرَفْرِفُ. أَفَهُوَ مَنْكِبٌ رَؤُوفٌ، أَمْ رِيشٌ؟
verses.kjv: [Gavest thou] the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
verses.web: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهَا تَتْرُكُ بَيْضَهَا وَتُحْمِيهِ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ،
verses.kjv: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
verses.web: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

verses.ar: وَتَنْسَى أَنَّ ٱلرِّجْلَ تَضْغَطُهُ، أَوْ حَيَوَانَ ٱلْبَرِّ يَدُوسُهُ.
verses.kjv: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
verses.web: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

verses.ar: تَقْسُو عَلَى أَوْلَادِهَا كَأَنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ لَهَا. بَاطِلٌ تَعَبُهَا بِلَا أَسَفٍ.
verses.kjv: She is hardened against her young ones, as though [they were] not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
verses.web: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ قَدْ أَنْسَاهَا ٱلْحِكْمَةَ، وَلَمْ يَقْسِمْ لَهَا فَهْمًا.
verses.kjv: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
verses.web: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

verses.ar: عِنْدَمَا تُحْوِذُ نَفْسَهَا إِلَى ٱلْعَلَاءِ، تَضْحَكُ عَلَى ٱلْفَرَسِ وَعَلَى رَاكِبِهِ.
verses.kjv: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
verses.web: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

verses.ar: «هَلْ أَنْتَ تُعْطِي ٱلْفَرَسَ قُوَّتَهُ وَتَكْسُو عُنُقَهُ عُرْفًا؟
verses.kjv: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
verses.web: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

verses.ar: أَتُوثِبُهُ كَجَرَادَةٍ؟ نَفْخُ مَنْخَرِهِ مُرْعِبٌ.
verses.kjv: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils [is] terrible.
verses.web: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

verses.ar: يَبْحَثُ فِي ٱلْوَادِي وَيَنْفِزُ بِبَأْسٍ. يَخْرُجُ لِلِقَاءِ ٱلْأَسْلِحَةِ.
verses.kjv: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in [his] strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
verses.web: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

verses.ar: يَضْحَكُ عَلَى ٱلْخَوْفِ وَلَا يَرْتَاعُ، وَلَا يَرْجِعُ عَنِ ٱلسَّيْفِ.
verses.kjv: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
verses.web: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

verses.ar: عَلَيْهِ تَصِلُّ ٱلسِّهَامُ وَسِنَانُ ٱلرُّمْحِ وَٱلْمِزْرَاقِ.
verses.kjv: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
verses.web: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

verses.ar: فِي وَثْبِهِ وَرُجْزِهِ يَلْتَهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ، وَلَا يُؤْمِنُ أَنَّهُ صَوْتُ ٱلْبُوقِ.
verses.kjv: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that [it is] the sound of the trumpet.
verses.web: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

verses.ar: عِنْدَ نَفْخِ ٱلْبُوقِ يَقُولُ: هَهْ! وَمِنْ بَعِيدٍ يَسْتَرْوِحُ ٱلْقِتَالَ صِيَاحَ ٱلْقُوَّادِ وَٱلْهُتَافَ.
verses.kjv: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.web: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

verses.ar: «أَمِنْ فَهْمِكَ يَسْتَقِلُّ ٱلْعُقَابُ وَيَنْشُرُ جَنَاحَيْهِ نَحْوَ ٱلْجَنُوبِ؟
verses.kjv: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, [and] stretch her wings toward the south?
verses.web: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

verses.ar: أَوْ بِأَمْرِكَ يُحَلِّقُ ٱلنَّسْرُ وَيُعَلِّي وَكْرَهُ؟
verses.kjv: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
verses.web: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

verses.ar: يَسْكُنُ ٱلصَّخْرَ وَيَبِيتُ عَلَى سِنِّ ٱلصَّخْرِ وَٱلْمَعْقِلِ.
verses.kjv: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
verses.web: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

verses.ar: مِنْ هُنَاكَ يَتَحَسَّسُ قُوتَهُ. تُبْصِرُهُ عَيْنَاهُ مِنْ بَعِيدٍ.
verses.kjv: From thence she seeketh the prey, [and] her eyes behold afar off.
verses.web: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

verses.ar: فِرَاخُهُ تَحْسُو ٱلدَّمَ، وَحَيْثُمَا تَكُنِ ٱلْقَتْلَى فَهُنَاكَ هُوَ».
verses.kjv: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain [are], there [is] she.
verses.web: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
